subject: VMWARE_ESXI_REFERENCE_GOVERNANCE
statement: The repository mechanically traces every VMware experiment from Tech Story to representative run and hash-bound evidence, derives non-closing acceptance associations from requiredTechStories, and gives PCI error policy its own portable test and parity obligations.
limitations: Historical pyVmomi task identifiers and initiating actors are not uniformly retained.
Historical VMware runs do not all conform to contracts/vmware-experiment-result.schema.json; VMW-AER-COR-001 has a canonical aggregate result but its raw runs remain external artifacts.
Representative run IDs do not imply that every legacy case has a canonical result.
Derived acceptance links changed when M06 was narrowed to TS-F4-06; this index is traceability evidence, not case completion evidence.
This reference-governance result cannot close a Qman product case, risk, implementation milestone, qualification profile, or release gate.
